summary: PBDB holds species- and genus-resolved fossil occurrences with age bounds, per-genus first/last appearance and occurrence counts, plus collection records for subsampling; the genus-trajectory test is buildable from it. Neotoma covers only the late Cenozoic and WoRMS has no time dimension, so both are partial; no ready-made subsampled richness-by-genus table was found.
next_step: Pre-register a PBDB extraction (marine animal genera, stage bins, shareholder-quorum or similar subsampling) and the definition of 'small' vs 'large' genus and of peak/decline; consider restricting to well-sampled marine invertebrate groups.
obstacles_confirmed: PBDB is dominated by shelly marine animals; plants and terrestrial genera are a thin remainder (not quantified here).
Unrestricted PBDB count queries (all occurrences for Animalia) timed out at 25 s; extractions should be chunked by interval or taxon.
